name: Dr. Santrupt Misra
education: B.A. (Honours), M.A. (Political Science), M.A. (Personnel Management and Industrial Relations), Ph.D. (Public Administration), Degree of Doctor of Philosophy (Industrial Relations) Educated at Utkal University, Odisha, Tata Institute of Social Sciences, Mumbai, Maharashtra and University of Aston, Birmingham, U.K.
permanent_address: PLot 301C, KHARAVELA NAGAR, UNIT 3, BHUBANESWAR- ODISHA Athagad 751001; At./Po.:-C/1209, Sector-6,CDA, Markat Nagar, Cuttack, Dist.:- Cuttack, Odisha 753014
books: Human Resources Management in Public Service, 1994
social_activities: Has served on Boards of Directors for profits/not for profits, educational, professional, and social organizations in India and abroad; has often been invited to address professional bodies and business organisations; has been a mentor and coach to many budding leaders in a range of fields; has been associated with many trusts and educational institutions and health care service providers
hobbies: Reading, travelling, socialising, current affairs, music and institution building
countries_visited: Widely travelled; U.K., U.S.A., Italy, Egypt, U.A.E., Mexico and South Korea
other_information: Won many awards and recognitions in his career; awarded, (i) NIPM Ratna Award, (ii) Prabasi Odia Sanman, (iii) Margadarshak Award for HR Professionals by FOSTIIMA Business School, (iv) ICC D.M. TRIVEDI Lifetime Achievement Award for contribution to Indian Chemical Industry, (v) Best CEO Award - CEO Magazine, (vi) Pritam Singh Award - Transformational Leadership, (vii) Mathai Award - Indian Business Schools Association and (viii) Best CHRO Award - National HRD Network (NHRDN); was President, NHRDN for 3 years; was Member, Certification Commission of Society of Human Resource Management (SHRM), U.S.A.; Eisenhower Fellow; Fellow: (i) National Academy of Human Resources (NAHR), U.S.A., (ii) Aston Business School and (iii) All India Management Association; was also Commonwealth Scholar; Honorary Fellow, Coaching Federation of India; Independent Director, (i) Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd., 2017-2020 and (ii) Karmayogi Bharat, 2023-2024; held various positions in Aditya Birla Group such as Global Director, HR, Global CEO, Carbon Black, Global Director, Chemicals, Director, IT, 1996-2024

positions.position: Chairman, Board of Governors, NIT Rourkela, Odisha
Chairman, Project Advisory Committee, Ekamra Kshetra Advisory Board, Government of Odisha
Member, Consultative Committee for the Ministry of External Affairs
